info.name: PayPal AI Agent (local)
info.description: End-to-end local testing for the PayPal payment-lifecycle agent. Import this and postman/local.postman_environment.json, select the environment, and run folders in order. Folders 1, 5 and 7 create/send real PayPal SANDBOX invoices.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Run first. If these fail, the backend isn't up on {{baseUrl}}.

item.name: 1. Chat: end-to-end happy path (run in order)
item.description: Uses {{threadId}}, which step 1 resets and every reply keeps updated.

item.name: 1. Start a new conversation + create request

request.description: Starts a fresh thread (thread_id omitted). The reply shows the details, a due date and the plan. Nothing is created in PayPal yet.

exec: pm.test('has message + thread_id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.thread_id).to.be.a('string'); });
const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.thread_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('threadId', j.thread_id);

request.description: Must be exactly CONFIRM. Saves the invoice id into {{invoiceId}}.

exec: pm.test('has message + thread_id', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.thread_id).to.be.a('string'); });
const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.thread_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('threadId', j.thread_id);
pm.test('reply mentions: draft invoice created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("draft invoice created"));

request.description: Creates a real sandbox draft and saves {{invoiceId}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('draft created', () => pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('created')); pm.collectionVariables.set('invoiceId', j.invoice_id);
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('draft created', () => pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('created')); pm.collectionVariables.set('invoiceId', j.invoice_id);
const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('draft created', () => pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('created')); pm.collectionVariables.set('invoiceId', j.invoice_id);

request.description: Open {{payLink}} and pay as the sandbox buyer to test PAID / refund.

exec: const l = pm.response.json().pay_link; if (l) pm.collectionVariables.set('payLink', l);
pm.test('has simulated_overdue flag', () => { const a = pm.response.json(); if (a.length) pm.expect(a[0]).to.have.property('simulated_overdue'); });

request.description: Only works after the invoice is PAID. Otherwise expect 400.
The API hides PayPal's raw error and returns 502.
Only events newer than {{lastEventId}} (what the chat polls).
Runs one check immediately instead of waiting 60s. 404 if APP_ENV isn't development.
Invoice must be SENT. The monitor then sends a real PayPal reminder (once per day). Check 'List events' afterwards.
Run 'List events': there should still be only one reminder event for today.

item.name: 8. Webhooks
item.description: Safe to run: never creates anything unless the webhook is configured.

item.name: PayPal webhook: invoice paid (needs PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID or WEBHOOK_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED)

request.description: Locally this returns 503 unless WEBHOOK_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=true. With it, the invoice is re-read from PayPal, so a fake PAID body changes nothing unless PayPal agrees.

item.name: PayPal webhook: other event is ignored
PayPal webhook: not JSON → 400 (or 503/401 if unconfigured)
